profile_text.body:
Shanghai AI Laboratory is a government-backed research institution focused on artificial intelligence development. The organization describes itself as inviting global talent to work in areas including large language models, embodied AI, trustworthy AI, AI for Science, and foundational platforms toward artificial intelligence development.

The laboratory operates InternLM, a Chinese open-source large language model used for academic research purposes. Beyond language models, Shanghai AI Lab has developed the Shusheng embodied intelligence full-stack engine (Intern-Robotics) to address challenges across data, training, and practical applications, and the Shusheng Duanyan scientific discovery platform that connects scientific language models, intelligent agents, experimental data, and automated equipment across the research workflow. The lab released ten "co-create with Shusheng" scientific AI joint innovation results in 2026 spanning life sciences, materials science, and deep space astronomy.

The laboratory emphasizes safe and trustworthy AI development through what it calls the "AI-45° balance principle," combining safety and performance development with causal reasoning approaches. It conducts risk management across assessment, training, foundation, application, and validation stages. Since 2022, Shanghai AI Lab has collaborated with over a dozen leading Chinese universities including Peking University, Tsinghua University, and Fudan University on joint doctoral training programs.
